resources.string: Sends this phone\'s usage to your Den-Watcher hub whenever the phone is on your home Wi-Fi.
On the hub\'s page, open Devices, add a device of the kind Phone and enter this code.
Tap Scan hub code and point the camera at the code the hub\'s page shows under Devices when you add the phone.
Locked by the hub, so this phone keeps sending to it and recording cannot be stopped. To change that, the hub\'s owner taps Allow changing the hub for this phone under Devices on the hub\'s page.
The hub allows scanning another hub\'s code or stopping recording until %1$s.
Point the camera at the code on the hub\'s page
This code holds no hub\'s address. Scan the one under Devices on the hub\'s page.
Records the usage and keeps it until the hub has it, for up to a week.
Start recording to send this phone\'s usage to the hub.
The hub last took the usage on %1$s.
No browser to open the page.
Scan the hub\'s code to send the usage.
Not on Wi-Fi: the usage is sent once the phone is on your home Wi-Fi.
The hub does not answer. Is the phone on your home Wi-Fi, and is the address right?
The hub has no phone with this pairing code. Add the phone in the hub\'s Devices with the code above.
The hub refused the usage. Is it running Den-Watcher 3.5.0 or newer?
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. If the hub misses hours, let Den-Watcher run without battery restrictions.

Of the data you chose to collect: the battery\'s charge and temperature, memory and storage used, the traffic of Wi-Fi and mobile data and, if you allow it, the Wi-Fi networks nearby, only to the hub on your network. Android lets no app read how busy the processor is.
Shown while the app records the usage, as Android asks for.
The hub answered on %1$s, not on your usual network. If you are not at home, another device may have the hub\'s address here and get this phone\'s usage.
When the hub answers on a network other than the usual one.

With them the hub can tell where this phone was: which room at home, and places you name, such as Work. Android gives them only with the location permission; the app never reads your position and starts no scan, it only reads the networks Android saw. They are kept until the phone is home again.
Read only while the app is open. Allow it all the time to also read them while the phone is in your pocket.
Read all the time, also while the phone is away.
Which data do you want to collect?
In the same groups as Den-Watcher\'s installers. What is switched off is neither read nor sent.
Locked by the hub, like the hub\'s address.
Traffic of Wi-Fi and mobile data
